content.text: {"abstained":false,"abstention_reason":"","answer":"The Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP) [E01] helps job-seekers and established craftspeople launch small businesses outside agriculture. PMEGP is a credit-linked subsidy scheme launched in 2008 that aims to generate employment opportunities by supporting the establishment of new micro-enterprises in both rural and urban areas, promoting self-employment among traditional artisans, unemployed youth, and other eligible beneficiaries in the non-farm sector [E01].","cited_evidence_ids":["E01"],"claim_to_evidence":[{"claim":"PMEGP is a credit-linked subsidy scheme launched in 2008","evidence_ids":["E01"]},{"claim":"PMEGP supports establishment of new micro-enterprises in rural and urban areas","evidence_ids":["E01"]},{"claim":"PMEGP promotes self-employment among traditional artisans and unemployed youth in the non-farm sector","evidence_ids":["E01"]}]}
